description: A small work board composed from five independent Swimlane facade widgets. Every lane reads the same SQL query; moving, creating, editing and deleting cards enter ordered SQL pipelines and finish by reading the board again. Backlog and Ready can create cards, while the other lanes only accept cards moved into them. After a card moves, a Monitor shows the event that could be sent to another board; replace or follow it with an HTTP Client targeting an hkp-mount:// endpoint to invoke another composed board without coupling the swimlanes to that board.

state.statement:
WITH
  moving AS (
    SELECT id FROM kanban_card WHERE id = $cardId
  ),
  destination AS (
    SELECT id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sort_key, id) - 1 AS old_slot
      FROM kanban_card
     WHERE lane_id = $toLaneId AND id <> $cardId
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT id,
           CASE WHEN old_slot < $toPosition THEN old_slot ELSE old_slot + 1 END AS new_slot
      FROM destination
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, min(max($toPosition, 0), (SELECT count(*) FROM destination))
      FROM moving
  )
UPDATE kanban_card
   SET lane_id = CASE WHEN id = $cardId THEN $toLaneId ELSE lane_id END,
       sort_key = (SELECT (new_slot + 1) * 1024 FROM ranked WHERE ranked.id = kanban_card.id),
       updated = CASE WHEN id = $cardId THEN datetime('now') ELSE updated END
 WHERE $operation = 'move'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM moving)
   AND id IN (SELECT id FROM ranked)

INSERT INTO kanban_card (lane_id, title, description, sort_key)
SELECT $laneId, trim($title), $description,
       coalesce((SELECT max(sort_key) + 1024 FROM kanban_card WHERE lane_id = $laneId), 1024)
 WHERE $operation = 'create'
   AND trim($title) <> ''

UPDATE kanban_card
   SET title = trim($title),
       description = $description,
       updated = datetime('now')
 WHERE $operation = 'edit'
   AND id = $cardId
   AND trim($title) <> ''

DELETE FROM kanban_card
 WHERE $operation = 'delete'
   AND id = $cardId

SELECT
  id AS cardId,
  lane_id AS laneId,
  title,
  description,
  row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lane_id ORDER BY sort_key, id) - 1 AS position,
  sort_key AS sortKey,
  created,
  updated
FROM kanban_card
ORDER BY lane_id, sort_key, id

items.placeholder: Drag cards between lanes or within a lane to reorder them, or use a card's Move menu. Click a card to select it. Backlog and Ready accept new cards; every card can be edited or deleted.
